soundness_flags.label: ass:common-covariance-bound / def:common-overlap-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The asserted positive-definite lower bound on Var[phi(O)] is impossible: the 4J indicator coordinates in phi sum to one almost surely, so the covariance is singular; Zhou--Tchetgen Tchetgen Theorem 7 does not supply this condition.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Abstract Gaussian decision results
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: No sampled-data lift, empirical calibration of rho, or application reanalysis is claimed.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The saddle, profile-regret, and active-face claims are conditional statements about the fixed abstract Gaussian experiment only.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:certified-computation
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Termination and convergence are asserted only for one exact rational/real-algebraic index and one exact finite incompatibility witness.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The certified hierarchy is pointwise in the declared decidable input and does not claim a uniform stopping level over the legal index set.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 7 assumes a Donsker influence-function class, Assumptions 2--5, bounded Y, nuisance consistency, and a stated nuisance separation condition; it does not state a full-rank lower bound for the covariance of the redundant 8J-vector phi(O).

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the impossible covariance condition with a positive-definiteness condition on an explicitly chosen 8J-1 dimensional contrast basis for phi(O), and redefine both score maps on that quotient space.

Restate the common-array QMD condition as a genuine local LAN sequence with an explicit tau_n scale and cite a LAN/QMD source that supports its exact remainder; otherwise retag it as a novel technical condition and justify it.

Strengthen the decision kernel with a generic strict-regret theorem or computable regime criterion comparing the profile hull with at least one additional named weak-identification interval construction.

recommended_next_step: Revise the common-array covariance/QMD assumptions before advancing; the abstract Gaussian saddle and pointwise certification kernel otherwise remains field-tier viable.
